title: Short exactness of abelian sheaves is detected on stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $0\to F'\to F\to F''\to0$ be a sequence of abelian sheaves on $X$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Stalks $F_x$, germs and the induced stalk maps $\varphi_x$ of a morphism $\varphi$ are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], an abelian sheaf being a sheaf of modules over the constant presheaf of rings $\mathbb Z$. The sequence is short exact in $\operatorname{Ab}(X)$ if and only if, for every $x\in X$, the sequence of abelian groups $0\to F'_x\to F_x\to F''_x\to0$ is short exact.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AG (lemma-abelian), specialized to the constant sheaf of integers; Sheaves, Section 007S (section-exactness-points), for the stalk criterion

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], the sequence $0\to F'\xrightarrow{f}F\xrightarrow{g}F''\to0$ in the abelian category $\operatorname{Ab}(X)$ of [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is short exact if and only if $g\circ f=0$, the short complex $F'\xrightarrow{f}F\xrightarrow{g}F''$ is exact, $f$ is a monomorphism and $g$ is an epimorphism; likewise for the stalk sequence $0\to F'_x\to F_x\to F''_x\to0$ of abelian groups, where a monomorphism is an injective and an epimorphism a surjective homomorphism.

source.place: Section 007S (exactness at points) and the definition of a short exact sequence

proof.text: If the sheaf sequence is short exact, then $g_x\circ f_x=(g\circ f)_x=0$ by the definition of stalk maps [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], the stalk complex $F'_x\to F_x\to F''_x$ is exact by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-exact-iff-stalk-exact], $f_x$ is injective by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-mono-iff-stalk-mono] and $g_x$ is surjective by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-epi-iff-stalk-epi]. Hence by Step 1 each stalk sequence is short exact.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AG (lemma-abelian), specialized to sheaves of Z-modules; Sheaves, Section 007S (section-exactness-points)

proof.text: Conversely, suppose every stalk sequence is short exact. First $g\circ f=0$: for an open $U$ and $s\in F'(U)$, every germ of $t=g_U(f_U(s))$ is $(g\circ f)(s)_x=g_x(f_x(s_x))=0$, so by [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] each $x\in U$ has an open neighbourhood $W_x\subseteq U$ with $t|_{W_x}=0$, and $t=0$ by the sheaf axiom for $F''$; thus $F'\to F\to F''$ is a short complex of abelian sheaves. Its stalk complexes are exact, so it is exact by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-exact-iff-stalk-exact]; $f$ is a monomorphism by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-mono-iff-stalk-mono] and $g$ an epimorphism by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-epi-iff-stalk-epi], the stalk maps being injective, resp. surjective. By Step 1 the sheaf sequence is short exact.
